verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a government employer-services agency, so the axis applies. However, none of the open esd.wa.gov guidance pages in the pack mention processing times for appeals, penalty waivers, amended reports, account reactivation or any other employer transaction. The authenticated EAMS portal was not examined, so it cannot add evidence either way.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
